completion_gate: A proved implication or counterexample, an independently verified contrasting actual rule, and an exact accounting for the finite source if available.
objective: Test when an unrestricted bond from a top distinction to an own distinction on a specified branch must increase with depth. Compare a general separation criterion with a second genuine limit-only rule and with the finite corpus of three-port, one-definition rules. This moves G7 beyond the single growing example and gives G17 a comparison under a fixed inventory.
status: Complete. In 664 sampled recursive rules, 432 have bounded minimum bond size, 69 have linear growth with existence at every depth, 154 have a linear lower bound conditional on existence, and nine remain open at larger sizes. At a fixed size, the unrestricted reachable depths are computable and eventually periodic.
stop_rule: Finish at a separating theorem and opposing examples with a census of the hypotheses, or the first specific mathematical obstruction.
title: When does a branching pattern read its depth?
